note: G(c) hard-slice cross-validation before build. All findings medium (0 blocker/high). Resolutions folded into design v2 §2/§3.0/§3.1/§5/§6/§7 and the implementation.

confirmed_themes.theme: heading SSOT incompleteness (the 5 BOUND sections each have their own emitter '## Heading' inline literal, separate from binding.heading)
confirmed_themes.resolution: v2: ALL 8 emitter headings source from the module (bare heading + '## ' prefix); guard forbids inline '## <heading>' literal; consolidates 4 copies -> 1.

confirmed_themes.theme: two orders differ (prompt-policy: claim-before-artifact; bindings: artifact-before-claim) -> a single module row order cannot drive both, and 'byte-identical' was unprotected (arrayContaining is order-insensitive)
confirmed_themes.resolution: v2: module pins PROMPT_POLICY_APPEND_SECTION_IDS (prompt-policy order) and the bound-row order (bindings order) INDEPENDENTLY; exact-ordered toEqual test on deterministic_runtime_append_sections + order assertions.

confirmed_themes.theme: required_fragments cross-check (clause 5) did not name its source surface
confirmed_themes.resolution: v2: run.ts DERIVES runtime-provenance-bindings.required_fragments from the module's other-4 section_ids (drift-proof by construction).

confirmed_themes.theme: the 2 truncation conditional sections have ZERO behavioral test coverage (non-exported, never populated in fixtures)
confirmed_themes.resolution: v2: export the 2 truncation emitters + behavioral matrix test asserting each emits its module heading.

issue_clusters.cluster: Q-C completeness mechanism unresolved (the strongest, 5 issues): success criterion claims a 9th-section gate but the leaned mechanism does not catch a section added AROUND the module
issue_clusters.resolution: v2 §3.1.4: enforceable pair = static source-region sweep (no inline heading literal) + behavioral fixture matrix activating every append path; §5 stays strong, backed by both; source-text boundary documented (G8 R5 lesson).

issue_clusters.cluster: activation omitted from the guard's per-row equality
issue_clusters.resolution: v2 §3.1.2: activation IS in the per-row equality + self-tests.
v2 §3.1.1 heading uniqueness asserted; §3.0/§3.1.5 required_fragments derived from the module.

issue_clusters.cluster: append_owner naming conflates emitter ownership with provenance-binding state
issue_clusters.resolution: v2 §3.0: field split into emit_owner (always_section | conditional_markdown) + provenance_binding_required.
